cost.notes: Tuition & fees for the newest cohort; nonresidents (incl. international) add Nonresident Supplemental Tuition of $39,270. Housing in a residence hall; health insurance $5,066 extra. Total shown is the California-resident cost of attendance.

pte.note: PTE is not listed among Berkeley's accepted English proficiency exams (TOEFL, IELTS, DET).

_tier_rules.scale: S = top ~5 nationally in that field; A = roughly 6-15; B = 16-40; C = 41-100; D = beyond. General tier also uses selectivity: S admits <=8%, A ~8-20% with SAT median >=1450, B 20-50%.
_tier_rules.absent: No tier when the college has no undergraduate program in that field (e.g. no undergrad business major at Stanford or Harvard, no nursing at MIT).
_tier_rules.basis: Editorial judgment informed by the CDS data in this repo plus widely cited program reputations; reviewed 2026-10-20 (v1).
